headline: Navneet Education shifts financial year reporting timeline
hook: Navneet Education extends its financial year
summary: Navneet Education Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding an extension of its financial year. This administrative change alters the company's reporting cycle for the current period. Retail investors should note this shift when comparing year-on-year financial performance metrics. No specific reason for the extension was provided in the filing.
why_it_matters: Financial performance comparisons may require adjustment for this period.
